host_note: Windows 11 shared workstation (Core Ultra 9 275HX); not a quiet machine: other builds, test suites and browsers were running
statement: This host is NOT a quiet machine. Classes are interleaved at random, so its load cannot create a class difference; it only raises the variance, which every target's MDE states.

method.reference: Reparaz, Balasch, Verbauwhede, 'Dude, is my code constant time?', DATE 2017 (dudect)
method.classes: class 0 holds the secret FIXED, class 1 draws a fresh RANDOM secret per call; public inputs identical; both classes reach the same public verdict (except duress_real_vs_duress, which compares the real and duress outcomes themselves)
method.interleaving: each measurement's class is an independent fair coin (ChaCha20), so machine noise is independent of the class: it lowers power but cannot create a class difference
method.inputs: every input of a batch is generated before any is timed, one slot per call; outputs are parked and dropped after the batch
method.clock: x86-64: lfence; rdtsc; lfence around each measurement (TSC ticks at the constant TSC rate, not core cycles); elsewhere std::time::Instant (ns)
method.measurement: calls_per_measurement calls of the production function through a non-inlined shim, black_box on every input and output
method.crops: dudect's 100 percentile thresholds 1 - 0.5^(10 (i+1) / 100), i = 0..99, from a discarded calibration sample of 20000 measurements, plus the uncropped data; values strictly below the threshold are kept; dudect also discards the first 10 measurements of each batch
method.test: Welch's t on each crop with online (Welford) moments; LEAK when |t| > 4.5 at any crop
method.power: MDE = 4.5 * sqrt(var0/n0 + var1/n1) per crop; divided by the crop's shift sensitivity min(|s|, 1), s = 1 - f(c)(c - m(c))/F(c), so it is the uniform shift of every measurement that would give |t| = 4.5; headline = the smallest over crops with >= 1000 measurements per class and |s| >= 0.25; mde80 = MDE * (4.5 + 0.8416) / 4.5 is detected with 80 % power
method.fraction_of: the smaller class median of the run (from an evenly thinned subsample), net of the clock's median overhead

verdicts.PASS: max |t| <= 4.5 and mde80 <= 0.01 of the net median
verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE-POWER: max |t| <= 4.5 but mde80 > 0.01 of the net median

false_positive_bound.note: normal approximation; the crops of one target are strongly correlated, so the true rates are lower

method.stopping: a target stops when its time budget ends; or, after at least 10s and 200000 measurements, when max |t| > 10 (decisive) or (non-control-leak targets) when mde80 <= 0.001 of the net median. The stop rule depends on variances, not on the sign or size of the class difference.
